method: Registered block footprint checked against Google 3D orbit. Heights and window proportions estimated from Street View; not a measured survey. Three tall Empire storeys versus two small storeys here provides an independent gross scale check.

inputs.front_proportions: July 2026 image: three projecting upper windows, middle wider than end bays; small inset opening between left and middle bays. Three shop divisions roughly 4.6, 4.25 and 4.15 m.
inputs.height_estimate: 2.65 m shop opening and 0.9 m fascia, 1.25 m upper windows, 5.35 m eave, 6.65 m ridge. Roof pitch approximately 20 degrees, not the former 10.5 m massing.
inputs.ground: Existing rough Nevill paving at front endpoints 0.737 and 0.825 m local; floor 0.85 m, level walls and shallow threshold. Rear ground 1.07–1.14 m intersects buried foundation; no terrain edits.

uncertainties: Metric dimensions approximately ±0.6 m; small fittings ±0.15 m.
Rear roof valleys and concealed wall openings have incomplete evidence.
Retain registered neighbouring access gap rather than inventing an extension into it.
